verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents an OIDC well-known discovery endpoint that lists protocol endpoints and configuration in machine-readable form, and it publishes Admin REST API documentation. However, the evidence never shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec for the Admin REST API, and probes of common OpenAPI/Swagger paths on keycloak.org all returned 404. Missing for 10: a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger spec for the Admin REST API, a machine-readable spec covering the full API surface beyond OIDC discovery metadata, and hands-on confirmation that such a spec can be fetched.
